# Chapter Six: Happy Hour

Vic got in the car and started her up, it was a little past 1 in the afternoon now, the paperwork had been done and he was officially assigned to the task force as the liaison for the priests of the order, not Jesuit, something about the order of the best or something. It was one of those damn names they give themselves to make them sound ultra-important when really it’s a couple of clergy sitting around a room arguing over the gospel and their interpretation of it. This group even had cool pinky rings with the head of a wolf that had ruby eyes, Vic wondered if he could get one, maybe Amazon would sell them.

He pulled out of the lot and back onto the main road heading for 270 and home. He got back towards Gaithersburg and decided to stop off in Bethesda before heading back to the house, it had been a bit of a shit day and he figured why not stop for lunch and a drink. About 20 minutes later he was pulling into a Longhorn right outside of the nice part of Bethesda and pulled into one of the empty parking spaces, it was after lunch but before dinner so the place was fairly deserted. He saddled up to the bar and told “Ruby” at least that is what her name tag said, Vic was fairly sure it wasn’t, but who was he to argue with advertising. He ordered a burger and a beer, laid down a 20 and watched some soccer match as it played out on the TV over the bar. Ruby brought him his burger, he picked up the oversized piece of meat and bread and took a healthy bite, he was actually surprised that he still had an appetite but he wasn’t complaining. As he drained the cold Miller and through about Sam and the situation that occurred he focused less on the body and more on the strange way that the Justice deferred to the priests. That was not protocol nor was it normal in anything he had ever seen. Not that he had been involved in many murder investigations, in fact this was his first, so really what the hell did he know aside from what was said in some training book he had read about securing the scene.

As he sat mulling over what he had seen, his burger growing cold and beer still in his hand, he felt the hairs on the back of his neck go up, He swiveled to try and see if a fan was on or if a pocket of air conditioned air had just hit him. But sitting next to him, uncomfortably close was one of the most beautiful women he had ever seen. She wore riding chaps and a joker vest over what was left of a black t-shirt that had since lost its sleeves and most of its neckline. The look was intoxicating at worst. Staring into those amazing green eyes Vic said “Hi, kind of hot for leathers isn’t it” and his inner male did a face palm and slammed its face against his internal male ID.

IT had been a while since he had talked too woman in more than a casual setting, even Jessica had pursued him, he was never one for being aggressive with women. She leaned in close, her Raven hair spilling onto his shoulder and giving him quite the V down the neckline which of course the only thing his brain register was, she was wearing no bra. The woman inhaled deeply and then once more, she cocked her head in the way a dog does when it can’t seem to grasp something “Who are you” she asked he stared at her for the moment, trying to get over the strangeness of the exchange, “I’m married” was all he said and of course the inner male began to pack its bags to leave. Lame, very lame yes he was married, but she had not asked that, she had asked him who he was, At the very least she was engaging him in conversation, so of course let’s be a dumb ass and send her away, that’s awesome. He thought.

Vic shook his head and tried to clear the effect this woman had on him, on a primal level “Your Vic, I mean, I’m Vic” he held out his hand to shake hers. Great now at the very least she will think you’re a married retard. He squashed the inner male, he wasn’t helping the situation.

She looked at his hand strangely and then did something he would have never thought someone would do. She licked the back of his hand. Which of course excited the inner male, and repulsed the inner married man. As with any male he was always at war. He loved Jessica and could think of no other life for himself, but there was always that primal male inside, the one who sized up every female as a prospective conquest, the one every married man ignores as best he can lest he be single and broke.

“Are you okay miss” he asked looking at her as she closed her eyes and seemed to savor the taste. Her eyes snapped open and suddenly she seemed to change, her green eyes went grey, no shit straight storm grey right in front of him and her nose seemed to alter a little, he wasn’t sure if it was the light or what. “You are of him” she said and then she was gone, it wasn’t she got up and walked out casually, it was like one second she was there and the next the door was swinging open. “Well what the fuck” Vic whispered, his lunch completely forgotten.

He looked around to see if anyone had noticed the exchange, but as far as he could tell the few patrons were still concerned with their own lunches to have noticed. He shook his head, this day is getting stranger and stranger, I better get home before a traveling band of Gypsies decides I need a curse on my head. He paid for his lunch and walked out the door.

Rebecca

She went back to her bike and pulled far enough away from the lone star that she would not be noticed when he came out but still within view so she could tail the car. She still had a mission to perform and wouldn’t fail. He was a member of Sowain’s line, it could not be mistaken, she had smelled him and it was familiar but when she tasted him, she knew for sure, that was what this was about, protecting the mortal line of the Alpha, suddenly she knew why her mission was important, it first she thought it just an errand something to keep her busy while the others did any real tasks that needed completing.

But now she knew this was the critical task, she was to follow and protect him and report back to the master. She thought she knew why he was asking her to get his address, any computer searches would likely be monitored somewhere and if the wrong person were to get ahold of that information then who knows what they would do with it.

She didn’t think he was planning anything with this one, He was cute and he had the bloodline, but she was sure he was just keeping tabs on him as he had others. There were those who wanted the line eradicated for fear of what it could do, there were things that had been done in the past, long before she had been turned that dealt with the line and weapons and skills, something that scared the older wolves. They would not discuss it just called it the great purging and left it at that, but she could infer a lot from the name and from the fact that her pact and others still ran from the order, there were hunters who picked off those wolves who got too public but they were able to hide for the most part going from city to city and staying off the grid. She caught a familiar scent again, this was not the first time she caught it, Rebecca looked around didn’t see anyone, possibly it was just still attached to her clothing from earlier, but she didn’t think so. was it possible that the Alpha had thought she needed backup on this. She didn’t think so Brock whose smell she distinctly picked out of the litany of smells around her would be here hounding her, he was a creep and had thoughts of his own on what to do during “Down time”.

Rebecca had spurned him more than once, and a few times he had gotten angry but Marcus had stepped in to calm the situation. No meant no even in their world, you did not disrespect a fellow wolf male or female. Had Marcus not stepped in she was pretty sure even at her young age, she could have kicked the shit out of the little creep. He might be older but he was a coward most definitely and would not engage in a straight up fight unless he knew he would win.

There was the scent again. It was odd to keep catching wind of him, if he had been on her it would be a constant smell, but it was coming on the wind, he would know better than to be down wind if he were trying to hide, unless he could not find a place that would allow him to observe from another angle, the streets did have a lot of buildings, possible he hoped the other smells would mask his. She would have to ask Sowain if he had her tailed, he would tell her if he had, until then she dismissed it and continued waiting for the man.

Brock

Brock had seen her enter the restaurant and within 10 minutes she had come out quickly and then gotten on her bike, what had she done, he wondered, ensure he was still there or actually talked to him. She might have learned who he was or she might have just taken a table to observe him. When he didn’t come directly out he thought he knew which one. She was always curious and sometimes it had gotten her into trouble. He had moved closer to the restaurant to observe knowing it would carry his scent to her. He was taking a gamble but there was little cover that would allow him to view the building and her directly.

He watched as the man left the building and entered his car, he pulled onto the street heading back towards the highway, Rebecca was behind him and he pulled out after her far enough back where she wouldn’t see him. It took only about 30 minutes until the man pulled into a suburb of Gaithersburg and into a drive way, once he was in Brock made the call and gave the address. Once that was complete he high tailed it out of there, he had to make it back before Rebecca did.

Rebecca

She watched as he entered the house, staring for a few moments wondering what it was like to go home to a family and kids, She knew he had a wife, she could smell her as well as the faint scent of children, this was a home with a family. She understood why Sowain would want it protected, this was his last ties to mortal life and the damage a pack could do on a place like this., she didn’t even want to think about it.

She pulled out and headed back towards the safe house in Rockville, she would report in and give Sowain the information he requested. She wouldn’t mention the close encounter as that might make him nervous, sometimes it was okay to keep secrets even from the Alpha.
